import json, subprocess, sys

def run(payload, raw=None):
    data = raw if raw is not None else json.dumps(payload).encode()
    proc = subprocess.run([sys.executable, '-I', '-B', '/workspace/submission/cli.py'],
                          input=data, stdout=subprocess.PIPE, stderr=subprocess.PIPE)
    return proc.returncode, proc.stdout.decode(), proc.stderr.decode()

cases = [
    ('empty runs', {'runs': []}),
    ('no events', {'runs': [{'banks': 1, 'load_balancers': 1, 'fifo_bytes': 10,
        'pifo_bytes': 10, 'refill_batch': 1, 'sample_period': 5,
        'borders': [0, 10], 'policy': {'kind': 'fifo'}, 'events': []}]}),
    ('one range fifo', {'runs': [{'banks': 1, 'load_balancers': 1, 'fifo_bytes': 10,
        'pifo_bytes': 10, 'refill_batch': 1, 'sample_period': 1,
        'borders': [0, 10], 'policy': {'kind': 'fifo'},
        'events': [['enqueue', 1, 0, 5, 0], ['sample']]}]}),
    ('inspect unknown', {'runs': [{'banks': 1, 'load_balancers': 1, 'fifo_bytes': 10,
        'pifo_bytes': 10, 'refill_batch': 1, 'sample_period': 5,
        'borders': [0, 10], 'policy': {'kind': 'sff'},
        'events': [['inspect', 99], ['cancel', 99]]}]}),
]
for name, payload in cases:
    rc, out, err = run(payload)
    print(name, '->', rc, out[:400], ('ERR:' + err[:200]) if err else '')

invalid = [b'', b'not json', b'{} {}', b'{"runs":[],"runs":[]}', b'{"x":NaN}',
           b'{"x":1e999}', b'\xff', b'{"runs":[1]}', b'{"runs":{}}', b'[1,2]',
           b'{"runs":[{"banks":1}]}', b'{"runs":[],}', b'{"runs":[]} trailing']
for data in invalid:
    rc, out, err = run(None, data)
    status = 'OK' if out == '{"error":"invalid"}' and rc == 0 else 'FAIL'
    print(status, repr(data[:40]), '->', rc, out[:80])
